title: Verify end-to-end: unauthenticated browsing and preview
body:
Phase 13 verification. Confirm that without a GitHub token:
- Dashboard loads and content directory is browsable
- Subdirectory navigation works
- Search and sort work
- Preview page renders markdown correctly
- Editor page loads file content and renders preview pane
- Save/Upload/Publish UI is hidden; 'Login to save' link is shown
